title: Around the meeting table
passage: A. People are carrying a table out of a room. B. A chair is being stacked on a table. C. Everyone is standing beside a doorway. D. People are sitting around a conference table.
passageZh:
A. 人們正把桌子搬出房間。
B. 一張椅子正被疊放在桌上。
C. 每個人都站在門口旁。
D. 人們正圍坐在會議桌旁。
